name: SYNTEC AIRFLOW SYSTEMS
india_angle: Syntec Airflow Systems is based in India and provides HVAC and cleanroom solutions tailored to the Indian market.
summary: Syntec Airflow Systems specializes in providing HVAC and cleanroom solutions, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and installation of air handling units and cleanroom equipment. Their offerings are primarily targeted at industries requiring controlled environments, such as healthcare and pharmaceuticals.
